title: Emit `synchronized` methods explicitly on the JVM

target.summary: Matching `Select(This(_), nme.synchronized_)` matches outer `this` references (such as `Outer.this.synchronized`), incorrectly transforming blocks synchronized on an outer instance into `synchronized` methods locking on the inner instance.
notes: faulty pattern match that matches Outer.this
definition of transformDefDef, the method whose behavior is wrong
definition of helper function extractSynchronized containing the faulty match
